channel.title: Cadence 步频 — PT Research Signal
channel.description: Daily curated physical therapy & rehab research for clinicians. AI-scored signal from 50 sources.

item.title: Updated Clinical Practice Guideline for Physical Therapist Management After TKA
item.description: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) has published an updated clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management after total knee arthroplasty (TKA), recommending new treatments and pain management tools.
item.author: APTA

item.title: Structured exercise training for fatigue management in multiple sclerosis: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
item.description: An umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses confirms structured exercise training effectively manages fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis, with effects varying across modalities and fatigue instruments.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty: revision 2026.
item.description: The American Physical Therapy Association has released a revised clinical practice guideline for the physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty, featuring 20 new recommendations based on a systematic review of current literature.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: First trial confirms swimming reduces disability from chronic back pain
item.description: The EduSwim clinical trial, an eight-week individualized physiotherapist-guided swimming and education program, significantly improved function and pain in individuals with chronic low back pain compared to education alone.
item.author: Medical Dialogues

item.title: American Physical Therapy Association: APTA Regulatory, Legislative, and Payment Updates Series (2026)
item.description: APTA's Health Policy and Payment team will provide an overview of the most significant federal regulatory and commercial payer policy updates for 2026, offering critical insights for physical therapists.
item.author: APTA

item.title: Proposed '27 Home Health Rule: 2.4% Increase Likely Reduced by PDGM Adjustments
item.description: CMS's proposed 2027 Home Health Rule estimates a 2.4% payment increase, but temporary PDGM adjustments are likely to result in lower total payments for home health agencies, with comments due by August 31, 2026.
item.author: APTA

item.title: Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility PPS
item.description: CMS issued the FY 2027 Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility Prospective Payment System proposed rule, proposing updates to Medicare payment policies and rates, with comments due by June 1.
item.author: CMS

item.title: Outcomes of rehabilitation following device-aided therapy start in parkinson's disease: a randomized controlled trial.
item.description: A randomized controlled trial (N=45) found that adding tailored primary care rehabilitation to device-aided therapy in Parkinson's disease resulted in better maintenance of patient motor skills at 6 and 12 months compared to device-aided therapy alone.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Neurocognitive training with visual perturbation improves dual-task hop performance in male athletes after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a randomized controlled trial
item.description: A randomized controlled trial found that neurocognitive training with visual perturbation improved dual-task hop performance in male athletes after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction.
item.author: BMC Sports Sci Med Rehabil

item.title: Effect of Combined Aerobic and Resistance Training on Exercise Capacity, Muscle Strength, Quality of Life, and Mortality in Patients with Coronary Heart Disease: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis
item.description: A systematic review with meta-analysis found that combined aerobic and resistance training improves exercise capacity, muscle strength, quality of life, and mortality in patients with coronary heart disease.
item.author: Sports Med - Open

item.title: Proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule: What PTs Need to Know, Part 2
item.description: CMS's proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule includes changes to the Quality Payment Program, potentially ending the Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) in 2029.
item.author: APTA

item.title: Advocates, Leaders Drive Payment Momentum During APTA Payment Advocacy Summit
item.description: The APTA Payment Advocacy Summit brought together advocates and leaders to advance physical therapy payment policies for practice sustainability and patient access to care, building on recent state payment successes.
item.author: APTA

item.title: External Validation of a Machine Learning Model for the Early Prediction of Upper-Limb Recovery After Stroke.
item.description: External validation of a machine learning model for predicting 6-month upper-limb capacity after stroke showed good performance in an independent Danish cohort. Predictions were generated from baseline assessments at 2 weeks post-stroke.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Local Coverage Determinations
item.description: CMS outlines Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), which define Medicare coverage for specific items and services on an intermediary or carrier-wide basis under Parts A and B.
item.author: CMS

item.title: Cost-effectiveness of stratified physiotherapy integrated with digital health versus usual physiotherapy for neck and/or shoulder pain: results of a cluster randomised clinical trial.
item.description: A cluster randomized clinical trial in the Netherlands found that a Stratified Blended Physiotherapy Approach (SBPA) combining prognostic risk stratification with digital health was cost-effective and superior to usual physiotherapy for neck and/or shoulder pain.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Effectiveness of an individualised swimming and education programme for chronic low back pain (EduSwim): a randomised controlled trial.
item.description: An individualized swimming and education program, delivered via telehealth over 8 weeks, significantly reduced disability (RMDQ) in adults with chronic non-specific low back pain compared to an education-only control group.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Effectiveness of an AI-based home exercise app for rehabilitation of rotator cuff-related shoulder pain: A randomized controlled trial.
item.description: A single-center RCT (n=46) found that adding an AI-based digital rehabilitation program to standard physiotherapy for rotator cuff-related shoulder pain may improve outcomes, potentially addressing adherence issues.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Remotely Monitored Home-based Pulmonary Rehabilitation in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
item.description: A randomized controlled trial (n=29) demonstrated that remotely monitored home-based pulmonary rehabilitation is feasible and effective for patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, improving exercise capacity and quality of life.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review exploring efficacy and optimal technique.
item.description: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 103 studies (44 RCTs, 9951 patients) found hydrodilatation for idiopathic adhesive capsulitis to be efficacious compared to other interventions, with a mean hydrodilatation volume of 36.0±26.3 mL.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Contralesional plantar peripheral electrical stimulation combined with contralesional posterior parietal cortex repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation promotes lower-limb motor recovery in stroke patients with hemiparesis: a randomized, double-blind, factorial controlled trial
item.description: This randomized, double-blind, factorial controlled trial protocol investigates if contralesional plantar peripheral electrical stimulation combined with contralesional posterior parietal cortex repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation promotes lower-limb motor recovery in stroke patients with hemiparesis.
item.author: J NeuroEng Rehabil
